name: dn-excluded-prefix-broken-by-rdn-reorder-valid
description: An excluded directoryName subtree (C=CH,O=another) does not match a leaf whose DN contains the same RDNs but in a different order (C=CH,CN=tester,O=another). The excluded RDN sequence must appear as a contiguous prefix to be a subtree match.
notes: When the RDN ordering breaks the prefix relation, the subtree exclusion does not fire.
